admittance.question: Which method maintains a constant MRR@10 value across all query counts?
admittance.why_unrecoverable: The black line representing this method has no unique visual markers (e.g., color, shape, or pattern) to distinguish it from other methods. Its identity relies solely on the text label in the legend.
admittance.expected_behavior: Model should admit it cannot determine this information

inductance.question: Which method exhibits the most fluctuation in MRR@10 values across the range of query counts?
inductance.reasoning_path: The blue line is visually distinct due to its star markers and fluctuating pattern. By observing the fluctuations and matching the line's style to the legend, the method name can be inferred.
inductance.why_inferable: The unique visual pattern (fluctuation) and star markers of the blue line provide sufficient clues to identify the method even if the text label is blurred.
inductance.expected_behavior: Model should attempt to infer from visual context
